system.description:
While many an outlander roams the wide world beyond the safety of a town’s walls, the vagabond is rarely interested in remaining in the wilds for any length of time. Craving the comforts of civilization, but not the attachments that come with it, vagabonds are wandering loners who blow into town, stay a while, and slip away when they feel they must.

Well known for turning their hard work and skilled labor into a night’s stay in a barn or a cheap room in some hotel or inn, the vagabond does their best to keep their head down and avoid trouble… rarely does it matter.

Ability Score Increase: Strength or Dexterity +1, any other attribute +1.

Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling, Deception, expertise in Deception to appear nonthreatening

Tool Proficiencies: Tinker Tools (Used for general repairs checks on houses, farms, and the like)

Suggested Equipment (Cost 4 gold 7 silver): Crowbar, hammer, mess tin, hemp rope 50ft, tinderbox.

Feature: A Day’s Labor. Honest labor hardly satisfies most adventurers, who prefer to use their influence or persuasion to gain themselves a night in an inn or an hour on a stage. But for the classic vagabond, holding your hat in your hand while asking honest folk if they have work that needs doing is the surest, and most honest, way to a hot meal and a safe place to rest your head. In exchange for 1 hour of labor doing repairs and tending animals you can secure a moderate lifestyle of good food and sleeping in sheltered haylofts away from the troubles and vices of a tavern or other place of ill repute.

Adventures and Advancement: While the call for skilled farmhands is common, it’s rarely going to garner the attention of the wealthy or renowned. However, your reputation as an adventurer will, soon enough, have people looking for you; either to employ you in a new venture or to seek payback for an old one. If you remain in town for a full week, your reputation catches up with you, and the settlement you’re in becomes your new ‘Prestige Center’ as word of who you are spreads.

Connections and Memento: Roll 1d10, choose, or make up your own.
